summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: @arv-bedrock/auth@1.1.7 declares a `preinstall` hook that runs `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from `github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases`, unpacks it to a tempdir, chmods it executable, and uses it to execute a sibling file `math_init.js` at the package root. math_init.js is a 727KB single-line heavily obfuscated Bun-CJS bundle (string-array rotation via a `WV8StW`-style decoder, `_0xNNNN` identifier renaming, opaque numeric/string tables) with no clear-text URLs or symbols; its behavior cannot be resolved statically. The package's stated purpose is an auth wrapper around axios and does not require the Bun runtime or a large obfuscated blob. Both `setup.mjs` and `math_init.js` sit at the tarball root and are outside the `"files": ["dist/**/*"]` allowlist declared in package.json, so they are shipped outside the author's declared publish surface. Installing this package on `npm install` fetches an alternate language runtime and uses it to execute opaque code that Node-based tooling cannot inspect — an alternate-runtime dropper against the installer.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
